note: Measured wall-clock for ONE consolidation cycle's deterministic tier over the committed fixture corpus. KTD11 asks U11 for a measured cycle duration as the fleet's capacity input; this is the half of it that can be measured without spending money.
method: evals/corpus.ts seeded into a real tenant database in its pre-consolidation state (evals/seed-tenant.ts + test/consolidate/fixture.ts), then all six deterministic phases, zero model calls. Postgres 17 + pgvector on a local container; median of three runs (259, 266, 267 ms).
caveat: A LOWER BOUND on a full cycle, not the cycle. It excludes every model phase, which is where a paid cycle spends its minutes — KTD11's own estimate for a whole cycle is 3 minutes, and src/worker/scheduler.ts:ESTIMATED_CYCLE_MS still carries that estimate rather than this number, deliberately: substituting a deterministic-only measurement for a full-cycle duration would make the fleet's capacity look roughly 675x larger than it is.

capacity_if_this_were_the_whole_cycle.note: quoted only to show the size of the error the caveat above prevents
